about: 28, lives in Bushwick, works at a gallery. Likes places with a creative crowd, a bit scrappy, music or art in the room. Hates anything sceney, corporate or touristy.
purpose: a 4-day solo trip, mostly eating, drinking and wandering

places.name: Roberta's
places.note: Wood-fired pizza in a scrappy warehouse with a garden. Feels like a friend's party, full of artists and musicians.

places.name: Metrograph
places.note: Indie cinema with a moody bar and restaurant upstairs. I go for an old film and stay for a drink.

places.name: Mood Ring
places.note: Tiny astrology-themed bar, DJs on weeknights, cheap drinks, everyone's dressed weird in a good way.

places.name: Dimes
places.note: Bright, plant-filled cafe. Healthy, creative food and a crowd that looks like they all make zines.

places.name: Sunny's Bar
places.note: Old dive bar in Red Hook with live bluegrass jams. Feels like nothing has changed in 50 years.

dislikes.name: Tao Downtown
dislikes.note: Loud club music, bottle service energy, huge and corporate. Felt like a theme park.

dislikes.name: Magnolia Bakery
dislikes.note: Long tourist line for an average cupcake. All hype.
